meta.scope: Nationwide directory of U.S. MD and DO programs, institution/location level.

coverage.grain: Teaching location / program level. MD from the LCME accredited-programs table; DO from the AACOM college directory (48 colleges at 75 teaching locations).
coverage.reconciliation: DO entries equal AACOM's 75 teaching locations exactly. MD entries are LCME's 163 programs plus 2 regional campuses LCME does not list separately (Sidney Kimmel Delaware Regional, Tufts Maine Track) - see knownDefects.

methodology: Directory completeness and school-specific admissions-profile completeness are tracked separately.
The AAMC OCD scope includes U.S. MD programs with preliminary, provisional, or full LCME accreditation as of June 1, 2026.
AACOM reported 48 accredited colleges of osteopathic medicine at 75 teaching locations as of June 23, 2026.
No acceptance rate was inferred from applicants divided by matriculants.
Median GPA, median MCAT, prerequisites, deadlines, AP policies, and situational-judgment-test requirements are null unless verified from an official source.
Some multi-campus institutions appear as separate entries where applicants may select or matriculate to distinct locations.
This expanded file is appropriate as a nationwide browsing/filtering directory. It is not yet complete enough for admissions-chance modeling.

2026-08-10: re-verified the MD roster against the LCME Accredited Programs table (page last updated 2026-07-22). Five newly accredited programs were absent and have been added, all at Preliminary status. Medians, deadlines, and prerequisites remain null by design — see tabs/08-school-list-board.md §1.
meta.freshness: Directory layer (name, city, state, degree, application service, accreditation) verified 2026-08-10 against LCME and AACOM primary sources. Admissions-profile layer (medians, deadlines, prereqs, situational-judgement requirements) is deliberately empty - student-entered per tabs/08-school-list-board.md section 1.

knownDefects.detail: Both keys exist on all 211 entries and are null on all 211. The schema author intended to ship this; nothing was ever populated.
knownDefects.whyItMatters: A school that REQUIRES a situational-judgement score may not mark an application complete until it arrives. PREview participation has three tiers — require, recommend, accept — so a boolean is the wrong shape.
knownDefects.openQuestion: Shipping this conflicts with tabs/08-school-list-board.md section 1: participation is a per-school policy that changes annually, which is the exact maintenance trap the ruling avoids. Either populate it with a per-field source URL and check date, or delete the keys and make it student-entered. Leaving it null on 211 entries is the one option that is definitely wrong.
knownDefects.fixSource: https://students-residents.aamc.org/aamc-preview/participating-schools (AAMC, updated as schools confirm) + each school's own admissions page for CASPer

knownDefects.detail: Filled on 211/211 but holds only 2 distinct strings — a verification disclaimer, not per-school content. It reads as populated in any fill-rate check.
knownDefects.whyItMatters: A placeholder that looks like data is worse than a null, because it hides the gap from exactly the audit that would find it.
knownDefects.fixSource: n/a — either populate per school or move the disclaimer to meta where it belongs.

knownDefects.detail: Sidney Kimmel Medical College - Delaware Regional Medical Campus (DE) and Tufts University School of Medicine Maine Track (ME) are in the roster but LCME does not accredit or list them separately. They are the only 2 of 240 entries with no city, because no directory lists one for them.
knownDefects.openQuestion: Keep them (applicant-facing: a student can select these tracks) or drop them (accreditation-level: LCME lists 163 programs)? The DO side is now consistently at teaching-location grain, so keeping them is the consistent choice - but then the same logic may add more MD regional campuses.
knownDefects.doNot: Do not resolve this by deleting rows quietly. It changes any count HQ displays.

corrections.detail: Baylor College of Medicine, Sam Houston State University COM, and UNT Health Fort Worth TCOM corrected AMCAS/AACOMAS -> TMDSAS. Texas A&M renamed to its official name.
corrections.verification: TMDSAS lists 14 medical member institutions; the roster held 11. 11 + 3 = 14, reconciled exactly. TCU Burnett confirmed correctly AMCAS - TMDSAS does not list it.

corrections.detail: Populated on 161 of 163 MD entries from the LCME Accredited Programs table via row-by-row optimal assignment within each state, not by count. The 2 unpopulated are the regional-campus entries LCME does not list.
corrections.verification: Every assignment reviewed; the 18 lowest-scoring pairs were checked by hand and all were correct (abbreviation and word-order differences only, e.g. 'UNC School of Medicine' vs 'University of North Carolina School of Medicine').

removedPartialData.detail: Three North Carolina schools carried medians while the other 237 did not - the remains of an abandoned NC-only pass.
removedPartialData.why: tabs/08-school-list-board.md section 1 rules medians student-entered. Three filled rows out of 240 make the field look live: a student seeing a median on Wake Forest and a blank on Duke reads the blank as 'no minimum' rather than 'not held'. Partial coverage of a comparison field is worse than none.
